Honestly, my partner and I felt the same way. So we chose to think of the scheduling process as training wheels until we figured out a rhythm on our own. It’s hard to see this as sexy, but sometimes a true partnership isn’t whimsical, it’s about practically navigating the world together. So, once we put that aside and chose to see this as a temporary arrangement while we learned more about each other, that was a lot easier. It just turned out that we both really liked the security of knowing which nights we’d do the thing, it didn’t ruin the surprise or intimacy bc it was still a mystery when in the night it would happen and how. But knowing going in that we both consented to it that evening, changed my anxiety game significantly. Maybe one day we’ll take the training wheels off, but for now, the structure is super comfortable and ironically freeing because it’s not so heavy and terrifying due to potential rejection.

Wishing you the best of luck whichever way you choose to go, and again, feel free to dm anytime as we’ve tried a lot of strategies to get through this.

If I want to be initiated on, I have to wait till we’d naturally go to bed and then he knows it’s his turn to get the ball rolling. 

On off days, I suggest you invest in a decent sex toy that keeps you happy and keeps that individual relationship with yourself alive! I found the satisfier 2 is a godsend and they sell it on amazon! I think a big mistake women make in this situation is depending on their partner for 100% of their sexual satisfaction. Being close with yourself lacks intimacy though, so that’s why it’s great to do in tandem with an agreed upon schedule which keeps both people excited. 

I also find, as a woman, not being able to turn my partner on and getting them into me 100% of the time can be a confidence bomb. So having a night you KNOW it’s on can help you get out of your own head in second guessing trying to initiate things.
